package distributor

import (
	"encoding/json"
	v1 "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseSpanTime(t *testing.T) {
	s := &v1.Span{StartTimeUnixNano: 20_500_000_000, EndTimeUnixNano: 20_900_000_000}
	start, end := startEndFromSpan(s)
	result := struct {
		StartNS uint64 `json:"start_ns"`
		EndNS   uint64 `json:"end_ns"`
		Start   uint32 `json:"start"`
		End     uint32 `json:"end"`
	}{s.StartTimeUnixNano, s.EndTimeUnixNano, start, end}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-windowed-discovery/span-time.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if start != 20 || end != 20 {
		t.Fatal(result)
	}
}
